action: Contact RoboRide local partnership coordinator to inquire about the diner kitchen participating in the new delivery network. Betty calls the number listed in the partnership announcement and asks direct questions: what are the requirements to become a delivery prep partner, what does the revenue share look like, how quickly can a small kitchen get set up. She is not committing — she is gathering information so she can decide whether this is a real option or a dead end.
